degradation_evidence.before: TIFFStartStrip() proceeded without checking codec initialization state, could crash on corrupted files
degradation_evidence.after: Added state consistency checks before attempting scanline access in WebP codec
degradation_evidence.impact: Harness using scanline-based access on files with corrupted codec state now returns error instead of crashing

gap_introduced.description: New codec state validation in tif_read.c prevents access to uninitialized state
gap_introduced.harness_needs_update: Yes - harness should cover both valid and invalid codec initialization states to maintain crash coverage

rationale: State check turns a crash into a graceful error return. Fuzzers looking for crashes must now reach deeper state to trigger similar bugs.

verification.method: Code inspection of tif_read.c, confirmed by OSS-Fuzz issue 26650
